resources.string: A Moment from this day in an earlier year, or one at random
The trip under way, or the last one
A bookshop by the sea, finally my turn
A square a day: Moments, spending or footprints, deeper for more

Sharing: only during an assisted share started in Here, reads the target app and runs its adapted steps. Stops before sending and does not store chat content. Currently supports Telegram and Threads photo shares and Instagram post captions, stopping if unfinished in time.\n\nAuto bills: once turned on in the ledger settings, reads the payment and bill pages WeChat and Alipay show, and reminds you in a notification to add the bill. It only reads, never taps or types, keeps nothing of the page and sends nothing off the phone.
